note: KOA Journey in Bluff Country SE of Spring Grove, between two bluffs on Riceford Creek (trout fishing); outdoor pool, mini-golf and over 4 miles of trails. TRA-owned but operates as a public KOA franchise. --Claude
summary: KOA pages + 2027 quotes: $40-65 mid-May, $45-75 mid-July (23-ft motorhome), 50 amp, 75 ft max, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/store/wifi, May 1-Oct 5 (pages disagree on the ends), KOA Rewards 10%. Passes the gate; Google 4.5 (289). WATERFRONT UPGRADE CANDIDATE: creekside, sites 52-61 back onto Riceford Creek ~25 m over open grass. Phone added in flags.
flags: WATERFRONT (reviewer decides; stored 'not waterfront', no --AWH): proposed 'creekside'. KOA's own site-type text: 'Back In, 50/30 Amps, Full Hookups Front Creek Side' - 'These 50/30 Amp full-hook up sites are back up to the creek ... close to the pool, mini golf and Kamp store' (sites 52-61 on the January 2026 map, the blue row outside the pool loop), and 'Full Hookups Back Creek Side' - 'in the rear of the campground ... near the dog park and the creek' (sites 84-90 on the map); a third type 'Back In, 30 Amps, Water/Electric Creek Side Grass' (green sites 62-72 between that row and the creek on the map) was not offered on either quote date. Imagery: the RV row NE of the pool loop sits about 25-30 m over open mown grass from Riceford Creek (a stream about 5-8 m wide, so creekside not riverfront); e.g. a pad at about 43.60328,-91.70663 with the creek at about 43.60328,-91.70629. The rear row near the dog park (84-90) has trees along the bank in imagery and was not judged. Waterfront evidence to record if accepted: 'KOA site types Front Creek Side (52-61) back up to the creek; Esri imagery: pads ~25-30 m over open grass from Riceford Creek (~6 m wide).'

PRIVATE GATE: passes. Base $40 (30-amp water/electric back-in, gravel) for a 23-ft motorhome on 2027-05-18, $45 on 2027-07-13; full hookups $55-75. No gateway within 40 km (Wisconsin Dells 156 km). Google Maps 4.5 from 289; RV Life 4.5 (stored). A KOA with an Extended Stays page ('a summer home away from home'), but nightly booking is the main business: no long-stay concern.
